t: What he said as evening came in
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ
p: Allāhumma asʾaluka khayra hādhihi-l-laylah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri hādhihi-l-laylati wa sharri mā baʿdahā. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-kasali wa sūʾi-l-kibar
m: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from a bad old age.
